name: Freepik
description: Freepik stock content and AI images through the Freepik API, now run as the Magnific API: search and download photos, vectors and PSDs, search and download icons, search stock videos, and generate images with Mystic.
instructions:
## Freepik
This connector uses the Freepik API, which Freepik now publishes as the **Magnific API** (`https://api.magnific.com`, documentation at docs.magnific.com; docs.freepik.com redirects there). The stock catalog is Freepik's: photos, vectors, PSD templates, Flaticon icons and stock video. Existing Freepik API keys keep working.

## Setup
Create an API key under **Account → Organization → API keys** on magnific.com (formerly freepik.com/api) and put it in `FREEPIK_API_KEY`. It is sent in the `x-magnific-api-key` header (the older `x-freepik-api-key` header name is accepted too). Keys are server-side secrets; the API has no OAuth.

## Costs
The API is billed in credits. Searching and reading details is cheap; every call to `freepik_download_resource`, `freepik_download_resource_format` and `freepik_download_icon` registers a download on the account, and `freepik_generate_image_mystic` spends AI credits. Those tools are marked as writes so the client asks before calling them. Download only what the user actually wants to use.

## Start here
- Photos, vectors, PSDs: `freepik_search_resources` with a `term`, then `freepik_get_resource` for licence, formats and author, then `freepik_download_resource` for a time-limited download URL.
- Icons: `freepik_search_icons`, then `freepik_download_icon` with `format` svg or png.
- Video: `freepik_search_videos` (a `term` is required).
- AI images: `freepik_generate_image_mystic` returns a `task_id`; poll `freepik_get_mystic_task` every few seconds until `status` is `COMPLETED`, then `generated` holds the image URLs.

## Filters
Search filters are sent as `filters[...]` query parameters. For resources, pass 1 on `photo`, `vector` or `psd` to restrict the content type, 1 on `freemium` or `premium` for the licence, and 1 on an orientation. Several flags of the same group can be combined. `language` sets the `Accept-Language` header (e.g. `es-ES`, `pt-BR`) so titles and the search term are handled in that language; the default is en-US.

## Licences
Each resource carries `licenses[].type`: `freemium` resources need attribution to Freepik/the author unless the account has a premium plan; `premium` resources need a plan that includes them. The licence PDF is linked in `licenses[].url`. Check this before telling a user an asset can be used commercially.

## Pagination and rate limits
Resources: `page` (1-100) and `limit`; icons: `page` and `per_page`. The `meta.pagination` object gives the total and last page. Limits: 50 requests per second per IP in a 5-second window, 10 per second averaged over two minutes, and 30,000 per minute per key; a 429 means wait and retry.

## Pitfalls
- Ids are integers; a resource id comes from the number at the end of a freepik.com URL (`..._1540200.htm`).
- Download URLs expire after a short time; download them right away instead of storing the link.
- `freepik_download_resource_format` only works for formats listed in the resource's `meta.available_formats`.
- Icon search answers 404 instead of an empty list for some filter combinations with no match (seen with shape outline plus free_svg free). Drop a filter and search again.

FREEPIK_API_KEY.label: API key
FREEPIK_API_KEY.help: On magnific.com (the Freepik API) open your account → Organization → API keys and create a key. Existing Freepik API keys work as well.

verifyHints.401: The API refused the key. Create a new one under Organization → API keys on magnific.com and check it is active.
verifyHints.402: The account has no credits left for this call. Top up or upgrade the API plan.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Too many requests: the API allows 10 per second on average over two minutes. Wait and try again.

tools.name: freepik_search_resources
tools.description: Search Freepik photos, vectors and PSD templates by keyword with filters for content type, licence, orientation, colour, period and AI-generated content. Returns id, title, preview image, licence type, author and stats per result.

order.description: Sort by relevance (default) or newest first.

language.description: Language of the term and of the titles returned, e.g. en-US, es-ES, pt-BR, de-DE. Default en-US.

photo.description: 1 to include photos. Combine with vector or psd; omit all three for every type.

period.description: Only resources added in this period.

author.description: Only resources by this author id.

ids.description: Comma-separated resource ids. Cannot be combined with other filters.

tools.name: freepik_get_resource
tools.description: Get one photo, vector or PSD by id: title, licences with the licence PDF link, available download formats and sizes, preview, tags, author and related resources. Check the licence here before downloading.

resource_id.description: Resource id from freepik_search_resources, or the number at the end of a freepik.com URL.

language.description: Language of the texts returned, e.g. es-ES. Default en-US.

tools.name: freepik_download_resource
tools.description: Get a time-limited download URL and file name for a resource in its default format. Each call counts as a download on the account and may cost credits; photos can be resized with image_size.

image_size.description: Photos only: small (1000px), medium (1500px), large (2000px), original, or a pixel width between 100 and 2000.

tools.name: freepik_download_resource_format
tools.description: Get a download URL for a resource in a specific format (psd, ai, eps, svg, png, jpg...). Use a format listed in the resource's available_formats. Counts as a download on the account.

tools.name: freepik_search_icons
tools.description: Search Freepik/Flaticon icons by keyword with filters for colour, shape (outline, fill, lineal-color, hand-drawn), period and free or premium SVG. Returns id, name, thumbnails, family, style and author.

order.description: Sort order when no term is given.

family_id.description: Only icons of this icon family (pack) id.

thumbnail_size.description: Thumbnail size in pixels, e.g. 64 or 256. Default 128.

period.description: Only icons added in this period.

language.description: Language of the term, e.g. es-ES. Default en-US.

tools.name: freepik_get_icon
tools.description: Get one icon by id: name, tags, style, family, thumbnails, free or premium status and author. Use it to check an icon before downloading it.

language.description: Language of the texts returned, e.g. es-ES.

tools.name: freepik_download_icon
tools.description: Get a download URL for an icon as SVG or PNG (or GIF, MP4, Lottie JSON for animated icons). Counts as a download on the account. png_size applies to PNG only.

format.description: File format. Animated formats exist only for animated icons.

tools.name: freepik_search_videos
tools.description: Search Freepik stock videos by keyword. Returns id, title, duration, resolution, preview and thumbnail URLs, licence and author per result. A search term is required.

language.description: Language of the term, e.g. es-ES. Default en-US.

tools.name: freepik_get_video
tools.description: Get one stock video by id: title, duration, resolutions, frame rate, previews, licence and author, and the download options available for it.

language.description: Language of the texts returned, e.g. es-ES.

tools.name: freepik_generate_image_mystic
tools.description: Start an AI image generation with Mystic from a text prompt. Spends AI credits. Returns a task_id at once; poll freepik_get_mystic_task until status is COMPLETED to get the image URLs.

prompt.description: What the image should show, in plain words, e.g. 'a ceramic coffee mug on a wooden table, morning light'.

model.description: Mystic model. realism (default) for photographic results, fluid for prompt adherence, zen for clean simple scenes.

creative_detailing.description: 0-100, detail per pixel. Default 33; high values look more artificial.

fixed_generation.description: true to get the same image again for the same settings.

webhook_url.description: Optional URL notified when the task changes status.

tools.name: freepik_get_mystic_task
tools.description: Get the status of a Mystic image generation: CREATED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED or FAILED, and when completed the list of generated image URLs.
